about_the_game:
This downloadable content includes a single avatar fully compatible with Animaze, featuring both ARKit-based, hand animations and standard facial tracking support.

Nash is a fun and energetic character inspired by the friendly Corgi dog breed. This avatar keeps the charm of the breed and fits perfectly in any virtual space.

Every part of Nash can be customized. You can change the colors and add hats, glasses, headphones, holdable props, or wearable items. This helps you create a look that matches your style and build your own digital identity.

Nash has smooth facial movements, expressive animations, hand tracking, full body tracking, and special action animations.

It is a great choice for streaming, online meetings, videos, and any virtual activity where you want to show your personality and creativity.

Features

  • Facial Animations
    Includes a standard set of facial animations for use with the Mediapipe tracker, as well as an ARKit-specific set designed for iPhone tracking. Both options provide smooth, expressive facial performance.

  • Color Customizations
    Every part of the avatar supports extensive color customization, offering users full creative freedom to match their personal style.

  • Props Attachment Slots
    Equipped with slots for a wide variety of props, including:

    • Hat

    • Mustache

    • Earphones

    • Glasses

    • Holdables

    • Carryables

  • Hand Tracking
    Supports all 70 hand animations for detailed and natural hand movements.

  • Full Body Tracking
    Compatible with Axis Neuron for full-body tracking, ensuring dynamic and lifelike performance.

  • Special Actions
    Features special actions retargeted from Animaze’s mannequin, enhancing the character’s versatility.

  • Fur Component
    Includes a stylized fur component for added visual depth and charm.

Includes 2 backgrounds with light setup: Lantern Street and Studio Podcast

This avatar content is developed by a third-party art team and will only be available in the Steam Live Service version of Animaze,  to Steam users who have purchased this DLC. It will not be included by default in any standalone historical snapshot of Animaze, and it will not be available outside of Steam.
